knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Hand hygiene breaks the route at the point where the hands would carry the infection to the mouth, nose or eyes.
Cuts are covered before work and standing water is not worked through without the controls. The water is reported.
Dated guidance is checked against current advice before reuse, and the check is recorded.

practicalCriteria: Maps a named infection route to the control that breaks it
Washes hands at the points the register names, and bags a contaminated cloth without reusing it
Covers a simulated cut before entering a waste area
Reports a simulated rodent sighting and a standing water hazard to the building facilities team
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: Work begins in standing water in a waste area without the register's controls
A contaminated cloth or item is reused
An infection entry is changed without a recorded check of current guidance
